units.title: SG-11.2.1 Subscribe BootScene.create to the transitionTo event
Act: Subscribe BootScene.create to transitionTo with fade-out and scene start
Verify: BootScene fades out and starts the scene on transitionTo unit tests

tests.id: bootSceneTransition > fades the camera out on transitionTo
tests.name: fades the camera out on transitionTo
tests.title: BootScene transitionTo fades the camera out on transitionTo
tests.scenario: Given BootScene is created; When transitionTo { sceneId: 'library' } is emitted; Then cameras.main.fadeOut is called once with TRANSITION_FADE_MS and scene.start is not called
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransition.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: bootSceneTransition > starts the scene only after fade-out completes
tests.name: starts the scene only after fade-out completes
tests.title: BootScene transitionTo starts the scene only after fade-out completes
tests.scenario: Given BootScene is created; When transitionTo is emitted; Then scene.start is not called until the camerafadeoutcomplete callback runs, and then it is called once with 'library'
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransition.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: bootSceneTransition > does nothing without a transitionTo event
tests.name: does nothing without a transitionTo event
tests.title: BootScene transitionTo does nothing without a transitionTo event
tests.scenario: Given BootScene is created; When no transitionTo event is emitted; Then fadeOut and scene.start are not called
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransition.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
